name: BranchScopePicker

props.description: Single compact Select for all/one branch; multiple keeps the existing all/subset editor.
props.name: selectionMode

props.description: Allow organization-wide scope. Set false for record fields, then validate exactly one permitted concrete branch on submit. Invalid supplied values are not silently coerced.
props.name: allowAll

props.description: Hide after a successful read of one enabled branch, except validation errors. Does not emit a change or normalize URL/default values; the app does that.
props.name: hideWhenSingle

props.description: Giá trị có kiểm soát: phạm vi đang chọn.
props.name: value

props.description: Giá trị khởi tạo khi không kiểm soát.
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: The selectable branches — consumer domain data.
props.name: branches
props.type: { id: string; name: string; description?: string; disabled?: boolean }[]

props.description: The controlled triad; default { mode: "all" }. Mode flips PRESERVE branchIds so switching back to all never destroys a curated subset.
props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange

props.description: Field VALIDATION message — rendered under the control and wired via aria-invalid/aria-errormessage on the radiogroup. Collection read failures are `listError`, not this.
props.name: error

props.description: Locked view: the current scope as a static summary (mode + branch badges).
props.name: readOnly

props.description: Built-in branch search above the checkbox list.
props.name: searchable

props.description: antd `notFoundContent` — shown when the branch SEARCH matches nothing (default: localized `dataEntry.branchScope.noMatches`). An empty `branches` list is `empty`'s job, not this.
props.name: notFoundContent

props.description: Override the localized radio labels (e.g. domain wording like 全店舗).
props.name: allLabel / selectedLabel

props.description: Native form name: multiple submits the MODE radio; single submits the Select key (`all` or `branch:<id>`). Serialize the public `{ mode, branchIds }` value yourself for domain records; native keys are not branch ownership.
props.name: name

props.description: DOM id on the picker root, and the SEED for the ids beneath it — the validation message is `${id}-error`, which is what `aria-errormessage` points at. Left out, a `useId`-based id is generated, so the association still holds; set it when a server-rendered page needs those ids to be stable.
props.name: id

related: CheckboxGroup / RadioGroup — the primitives underneath; use them directly for non-scope choices.
Transfer — large two-list assignment; BranchScopePicker is the compact all-vs-subset scope idiom.
TreeSelect — hierarchical selection when branches nest.
tagline: Canonical scope control: all branches vs an explicit subset.
usage: Use selectionMode=single in Sidebar action (above navigation) and a Sheet opened from MobileShell tabBar More. These are compositions, not a new switcher. OrgSwitcher changes organization and stays in platform chrome.

The app owns URL parsing, validation against authorized branches, popstate/router updates, and onValueChange navigation. Resolve a single authorized branch in the app before hiding the picker. Viewing scope is not record ownership: record forms use separate state, selectionMode=single and allowAll=false, and validate exactly one permitted id on submit. Future groups need an explicit value contract; do not encode them as branch ids.
DO treat scope as ONE form field: the single { mode, branchIds } value goes through FormField like any other control.
DO import it from @godxjp/ui/data-entry — never compose an ad-hoc radio+checkbox scope block per screen.
DO use `error` ONLY for validation (e.g. mode=selected with zero branches checked); a failed branch fetch is `listError`, a 403 is `denied`.
DO NOT preselect branches for the user — default is { mode: "all" }; an explicit subset is a user decision.
useCases: Role/permission assignment scoped to branches (service role forms).
Report or notification audience: whole org vs selected branches.
Read-only scope display on a detail screen (readOnly).
